---
title: "Quality Control"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source("R/read_manifest.R")
source("R/read_summary.R")
source("R/tables.R")
source("R/plot_helpers.R")

result_dir <- "data"
manifest <- read_manifest(result_dir)
qc_step <- find_step(manifest, "qc")
qc_summary <- if (!is.null(qc_step)) read_step_summary(result_dir, qc_step$summary) else NULL
```

## QC Summary

```{r qc-status}
if (is.null(qc_summary)) {
  cat("QC summary not available.")
} else {
  cat(paste0("Status: **", qc_summary$status, "**  "))
  cat(paste0("Timestamp: ", qc_summary$timestamp))
}
```

## Sample Filtering Statistics

```{r qc-table}
if (!is.null(qc_summary)) {
  knitr::kable(render_qc_table(qc_summary), format = "html")
} else {
  cat("No QC data available.")
}
```

## QC Plots

```{r qc-plots, fig.cap="Per-sample QC violin plots", out.width="100%"}
if (!is.null(qc_summary)) {
  img_path <- find_artifact(qc_summary, "png")
  if (!is.null(img_path)) {
    display_image(result_dir, img_path)
  } else {
    cat("No QC plot found in summary.")
  }
}
```
